reviews.t: Very soothing for children (or adults) with fevers.
reviews.x: I discovered these Be Koool gel sheets several years ago while I was working at Walgreens. They are soft, gel-like pads that stick to a child's (or sometimes an adult's) forehead that disperse a continual, cooling sensation. They stick well but it does not hurt to take it off. The are completely safe to use with medicine and the relief last for several hours. These can be hard to find at the store, so I am really glad that I found them here on Amazon. This order came with three boxes. There are

This is a great product! I used these gel sheets on my 3 year old when she had a fever for several days. The gel sheet stayed on her head even when she was sleeping. This is such a great alternative to using a wet washcloth, and my daughter doesn't mind it on her head. It kept her head cool even with a 102 fever. My daughter also likes the Disney characters on the gel sheet. I've looked in retail stores and haven't been able to find these. Thank you to Amazon for having them in stock!

I know they say they're fever strips for kids, but these gel sheets are great for those bangs and bruises in funny spots. reviews.t: I feel a little better if I fall asleep and she has this on ...
reviews.x: This product works wonders for parents who have to constantly watch a child with a fever that goes up and down.  At night, I feel a little better if I fall asleep and she has this on her forehead. It can help the fever, but do not depend on it to solely work on its own without home remedies or Rx. My child was afraid that her hair would get stuck to the gel and hurt when we had to take it off, but it didn't. She knows that she gets to put this on her forehead, legs and arms when she has a fever
Works great! My 3 year old leaves them on. Much better than hold a cold washcloth on her forehead

I can take my medicine, lie down, and not worry about holding an ice pack on my head. I've tried other head wraps and such, they may be colder, but this stays cool longer, thus it is almost always the most beneficial for me. I use the fun, adorable child size ones because the ones for adults were too big for my

These are GREAT! Nighttime fevers stand no chance! These are so handy and work very well. It's bad enough you have a kiddo wake up in the middle of the night with a fever...you have to get a washcloth, wet it down, then deal with the "my pillow is wet" or "this won't stay on". Not with these! Stick them on their forehead (or lower back/tummy for those really high fevers) and you're all set!

reviews.t: Great for migraine pain til the meds kick in
reviews.x: These things are the best while you're waiting for your migraine meds to kick in. They totally don't last 8 hours. They last like 2 or 3. But so worth it. They smell vaguely of menthol at the start but that fades. You can cut them into smaller pieces which is nice if you have that one vein than is killing you. The kid's size is nice too if you're like me and have a small head. :)

If the cool sensation wears off too soon, we have put the patch in the freezer for a few minutes to cool it down and "re-charge" it. reviews.x: I use this overnight with my really bad knees that always seem to be swollen.  You do have to tape it down because the sticky stuff in the back just won't stick well.  I use Kinesio tape to keep it in place overnight.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the gel sheets for providing soothing, cooling relief for fevers in children and adults.
Many reviewers report the sheets stay in place well, even while a child sleeps, and are easy to remove without discomfort.
A common theme is that the sheets are a convenient alternative to a wet washcloth, avoiding issues like a wet pillow or the cloth not staying on.
Several reviewers use the product for headaches and migraines, finding it helpful while waiting for medication to take effect.
Some reviewers note the cooling effect does not last the full advertised duration, lasting only a few hours.
